title: Choose Defixum's visual world
question: The roll picked Open Sky. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. All three are outdoors and calm, as you asked.

options.label: Open Sky
options.lineage: the real sky at the current hour, over a low ridge line
options.thesis: Every pause happens under the sky you'd see if you looked up from the screen right now.
materials: layered sky gradients that track the clock
sun and moon as the countdown
options.viewport: Pause: a full-bleed sky for this hour, a dark ridge along the bottom, and the countdown as the sun (or moon at night) in the middle. The message sits in the open sky and the choices rest on the ridge. Settings window: a thin live sky band across the top and calm earth-tone panels below.
options.risk: If the gradients are muddy or the ridge is clip-art, it reads as a screensaver instead of a place.

raised.raise: Time is drawn to scale: pause length, open-for minutes and unlock time left are lengths along the horizon, not just numbers.
The settings window drops padded cards for one hairline-ruled sheet, so a whole rule fits on screen without scrolling.
Daily minute limits read as a fixed day-length that fills up and can't overflow.
One clock value drives the whole palette continuously, so the sky drifts with the light instead of jumping between themes.

options.label: Trail Map
options.lineage: national park trail maps and routed-wood trailhead signs
options.thesis: Each rule is a trail, and the pause is the trailhead sign where you decide whether to go in.
options.viewport: Pause: contour rings tightening around a summit as the countdown, with a wooden trailhead sign holding the message and the choices. Settings window: rules listed like trails in a map legend, each with its own symbol.
options.risk: Familiar: outdoorsy brands lean on topo lines and park signage often, so it can feel like merch.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: The app as a park map: each rule is a land lobe of flat color with water showing through.
options.viewport: Pause: one green lobe swells across the screen, the countdown opens a pool in its middle, and capsule buttons sit on the coast.
options.case: Strong outdoors identification and friendly for the general public, but its cheerful overshoot motion and bright capsules fight the calm you asked for.
options.risk: Reads playful and touristy rather than calming.

options.label: Dance Score
options.thesis: Time flows upward on a center staff, each action's length is its exact duration.
options.viewport: A vertical staff with the countdown rising up it.
options.case: No outdoors identification and hard for the general public to read.

options.label: High-Density Grid
options.thesis: Pack every module edge to edge with hairlines and red tabs.
options.viewport: A dense mosaic of rule modules.
options.case: Density is the opposite of the calm you asked for.
options.kept: A strict hairline system instead of padded cards.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: Each side holds exactly forty-five minutes, no more.
options.viewport: Rules as tracklists with running times.
options.case: Nostalgic, not outdoorsy, and the metaphor muddles what a rule is.
options.kept: Time as a fixed capacity that can't overflow.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: One slider morphs the whole page live.
options.viewport: A giant glyph breathing with the countdown.
options.case: No connection to calm or the outdoors.
options.kept: One value driving the whole page continuously.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.thesis: Thousands of stamp-sized cells, circled in biro.
options.case: Busy and niche; the opposite of calm.
options.kept: Marked state by hand: circled and struck through.

canonCard.label: Wellness app standard
canonCard.thesis: What meditation and focus apps ship, done carefully.
canonCard.viewport: A soft gradient with a breathing circle and two rounded buttons.
canonCard.risk: Looks like Calm, Headspace and every focus app.
